scope: GNK DINAMO Ltd. Group / GNK ASG Enterprise Digital Platform
principles: Human executive control for binding, legal, financial, public, registry, security and deployment decisions
Every recommendation must be attributable, reviewable and reversible where technically possible
Separation of drafting, review, approval and execution
No impersonation of a confirmed human employee
No public factual claim without source and quality review
No hidden automatic publication, mass email, deploy, DNS, Cloudflare or secret change

roles.may: research, classify, draft, compare options, execute approved low-risk tasks
roles.mayNot: bind the group, publish, deploy or approve own work

roles.may: verify sources, completeness, policy, risk and rollback
assign work, return drafts, approve low-risk internal operations
roles.mayNot: approve critical or externally binding action

roles.may: coordinate departments, consolidate proposals, score risk and impact
orchestrate cross-department work and escalate high-risk proposals
approve, reject, defer or condition critical and external actions

proposalProtocol.sourceRule: Use at least one primary source for legal, registry, financial, technical or public factual claims; use a second independent source where material risk exists.

decisionMatrix.examples: internal formatting, tagging, non-public metadata review
public draft, SEO recommendation, workflow configuration without execution
decisionMatrix.decides: AI Manager or named human owner

decisionMatrix.examples: public publication, media statement, legal content, registry submission, campaign configuration
decisionMatrix.decides: AI Director routes to human authority

decisionMatrix.examples: deploy, DNS, Cloudflare, secrets, mass email, financial commitment, binding legal act

operatingProtocols.name: Research and evidence
steps: Stop and escalate if evidence is insufficient

operatingProtocols.name: Peer and quality review
steps: Return, approve for next gate or escalate

operatingProtocols.name: Decision
steps: Do not execute while approval is pending

operatingProtocols.name: Audit and learning
steps: Update protocol only through controlled change

operatingProtocols.name: Escalation
steps: Escalate legal ambiguity, conflicting evidence, security incident, cost variance, missed deadline or reputational risk
